experiment.title: Consider quantized cache after 8K measurements
experiment.implementation: Protocol only. Upstream quantized-FA overflow fix #29340 is a prerequisite; no candidate, patch or precision change staged.
experiment.only_change: A later isolated F16-versus-Q8 KV precision trial, keeping context and all other settings fixed.
experiment.hypothesis: Smaller KV storage may recover headroom if actual logs show meaningful savings.
prerequisites: Explicit testing go-ahead for any --run command
Offline validation receipt matches current sources
Quiet host; leave unrelated VM/build work alone
proof: Backport and GPU math validation of applicable quantized attention fix first
Actual KV savings separated from recurrent/QSA state
Recall/continuation/rollback parity and fresh ABBA complete-task metrics
stop_if: Unexpected quality failure or new swap
experiment.limits: A KV precision change does not shrink expert weights or all recurrent state. Current F16 profile is unaffected by the quantized-FA issue.

comparison.adoption_gate: At least 5 percent median complete-task improvement on the chosen workload, or useful capacity gain with an explicitly accepted speed tradeoff; no unexplained quality failure or new swap. Report control drift and all raw passes.
comparison.percentage_rules: TPS gain = 100*(candidate/control-1). Time reduction = 100*(1-candidate/control). Requires finite positive matched metrics. Do not add percentages from separate experiments.
